d:
The galleries currently uploaded for this only seem to include the textless files, so here's an upload of the versions with dialogue included. Also, since the artist grouped all the images based off the same source pose as lettered variants of the same file name, alphabetizing them would mean everything was out of order - so I've also sorted them so that the images appear ordered like they are in the work itself.

Edit: god damn it, the directory structure I used to get these images in the right order for the zip file isn't carrying through to the uploaded images, so unfortunately, everything is STILL out of order in the gallery. I'll see if I can fix that without manually renaming everything later this week, but for now, I guess we have to put up with it. (At least the dialogue versions are uploaded now.)

Unfortunately, I only have the smaller file-size versions of these images - I lost the full archive in a hard drive failure. If anybody can source a complete copy of the original work, I might be willing to sort the larger images similarly, but right now, what you see is what I've got, so I'm posting that.
